meta.description: Expose ralph loop operations as MCP tools with unified settings, live provider/model discovery with cost/best-for metadata, async job management, AI summarizer, dashboard integration, and settings UI page

phases.name: Settings Extension
phases.description: Extend vista/settings.json with the ralph configuration section and add settings loading/filtering logic to the config and provider services

tasks.name: Define ralph settings schema with model metadata
tasks.description: Add the 'ralph' section to settings.json with defaults, summarizer config, per-provider model filtering (models_allowed/models_blocked), and per-model metadata (cost_tier, best_for_tags, best_for_notes). Cost tiers: free/cheap/moderate/expensive. Best-for tags from curated list plus freeform notes. All informational — LLM uses judgment, no hard rules enforced.

tasks.name: Add settings loading functions
tasks.description: Add get_ralph_settings(), get_ralph_defaults(), get_summarizer_config() to the config module. Handle missing/partial ralph section gracefully with sensible defaults.

tasks.name: Extend provider service with ralph context filtering and metadata
tasks.description: Add get_ralph_providers() that: (1) calls provider.get_models() for LIVE discovery (same as ralph.py line 295), (2) applies models_allowed/models_blocked filtering from settings, (3) enriches each model with cost_tier, best_for_tags, best_for_notes metadata from settings. Both top-level and ralph.providers must be enabled. Models not in get_models() output are silently ignored even if in settings.

tasks.name: Add get_summarizer_command to Provider base class
tasks.description: Add method to Provider base class and implement in ClaudeProvider and OpenCodeProvider for spawning summarizer subprocess with specific model.

tasks.name: Write settings tests
tasks.description: Unit tests for filtering logic (allowlist, blocklist, both levels, missing section, empty arrays, invalid config), defaults resolution, and summarizer config loading.

acceptanceCriteria: get_ralph_providers() calls provider.get_models() live (same as ralph.py) — never hardcoded
get_ralph_providers() returns only providers enabled at both levels
Per-model allowlist intersects with live models (only allowed models that actually exist)
Per-model blocklist subtracts from live models (excludes blocked models)
Allowlist takes precedence when both allowlist and blocklist present
Models not in get_models() output are silently ignored even if in settings
Each model enriched with cost_tier, best_for_tags, best_for_notes from metadata
Models without metadata get null cost_tier and empty arrays
Missing ralph section falls back to top-level providers with all models, no metadata
get_ralph_defaults() returns configured or default values
get_summarizer_config() returns configured provider and model
save_ralph_settings() writes back to settings.json preserving other sections
All settings tests pass

phases.name: Job Management Service
phases.description: Create the RalphService that handles job lifecycle, directory structure, subprocess spawning, and state management

tasks.name: Create RalphService class
tasks.description: New service with create_job(), get_job(), get_job_status(), stop_job(), list_jobs(), find_job_by_slug() methods. Job state persisted to job.json files in .vista/ralph/{slug}/ directories.

tasks.name: Implement job directory creation
tasks.description: create_job() creates .vista/ralph/{slug}/ with job.json, task.md (from task_description), and generates PROMPT_{mode}.md from existing portable templates. Handles duplicate slug detection (error if active job, rename old job.json if completed).

tasks.name: Implement subprocess spawning (reuse ralph.py exactly)
tasks.description: Import LOOP_SCRIPT_TEMPLATE and get_prompt_content from portable/ralph.py. Generate loop script via LOOP_SCRIPT_TEMPLATE.format() with provider.get_invocation('ps1') — identical to ralph.py lines 208-218. Run via subprocess.Popen(['powershell', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', ...]) with stdin=DEVNULL, stdout to output.log. Same cwd, same flags, same template — only difference is Popen (non-blocking) instead of run (blocking).

tasks.name: Implement PID-based status checking
tasks.description: get_job_status() reads job.json, checks if PID is alive (platform-specific: os.kill(pid,0) on Unix, ctypes/psutil on Windows), reads tail of progress.txt, parses current iteration. Updates job.json status to 'failed' or 'completed' if PID is dead.

tasks.name: Implement job stop
tasks.description: stop_job() sends termination signal to subprocess (SIGTERM on Unix, TerminateProcess on Windows), waits briefly, updates job.json status to 'stopped'.

tasks.name: Implement prompt template generation
tasks.description: Read existing templates from vista/portable/templates/PROMPT_plan.md and PROMPT_build.md. Adapt for ad-hoc context: replace specs/ references with task.md, inject correct paths for .vista/ralph/{slug}/ working directory.

tasks.name: Write job management tests
tasks.description: Unit tests for job creation, status checking, PID verification (mocked), duplicate slug handling, stop behavior, prompt generation. Integration test for create->status->stop lifecycle.

acceptanceCriteria: create_job() creates correct directory structure with all required files
create_job() spawns subprocess and returns within 5 seconds
get_job_status() returns accurate status based on PID check
get_job_status() reads last N lines from progress.txt
get_job_status() returns within 1 second
stop_job() terminates subprocess and updates status
Duplicate slug with active job returns error
Duplicate slug with completed job creates new job, preserves old
Job state persists across service restarts (read from disk)
Prompt templates are correctly adapted for ad-hoc context
All job management tests pass

phases.name: Summarizer Agent
phases.description: Implement the summarizer that reads job artifacts and produces AI-generated summaries via a configurable CLI subprocess

tasks.name: Implement summarizer prompt builder
tasks.description: Build the summarizer prompt from job artifacts: task.md, progress.txt (last 100 lines), IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (first 500 lines), git log --oneline. Handle missing/empty files gracefully.

tasks.name: Implement summarizer subprocess invocation
tasks.description: Spawn CLI subprocess using configured provider/model. Pipe prompt via stdin, capture stdout. 55-second timeout (buffer for MCP 60s limit). Kill subprocess on timeout.

tasks.name: Implement output parsing
tasks.description: Parse JSON from summarizer output. Handle edge cases: non-JSON output (return raw text fallback), partial JSON, empty output. Extract status_summary, completed_work, in_progress, issues, recommendations, key_files_changed.

tasks.name: Write summarizer tests
tasks.description: Unit tests for prompt building (various artifact states), output parsing (valid JSON, malformed, empty), truncation logic. Integration test with mocked CLI subprocess.

acceptanceCriteria: Summarizer prompt includes all available artifacts with correct truncation
Summarizer uses configured provider and model from settings
Summarizer subprocess times out at 55 seconds and is killed
Valid JSON output is parsed into structured summary
Malformed output falls back to raw text response
Missing artifacts are handled gracefully (not crash)
All summarizer tests pass

phases.name: MCP Tool Registration
phases.description: Register the 5 ralph MCP tools in vista/mcp_server.py and wire them to the services

tasks.name: Register ralph_providers tool
tasks.description: Add @mcp.tool() decorated function in mcp_server.py. Calls get_ralph_providers() which discovers models LIVE via provider.get_models(), filters, and enriches with cost_tier/best_for metadata. Returns JSON with providers (including per-model metadata), defaults, summarizer config. LLM uses metadata to autonomously pick the best model for the task.

tasks.name: Register ralph_start tool
tasks.description: Add @mcp.tool() decorated function. Validates parameters, resolves defaults from settings, calls RalphService.create_job(). Returns job_id and status JSON.

tasks.name: Register ralph_status tool
tasks.description: Add @mcp.tool() decorated function. Calls RalphService.get_job_status(). Returns lightweight status JSON.

tasks.name: Register ralph_summary tool
tasks.description: Add @mcp.tool() decorated function. Calls SummarizerService.summarize(). Returns structured summary JSON.

tasks.name: Register ralph_stop tool
tasks.description: Add @mcp.tool() decorated function. Calls RalphService.stop_job(). Returns confirmation JSON.

tasks.name: Initialize services in MCP lifespan
tasks.description: Instantiate RalphService and SummarizerService in the _vista_lifespan context manager. Pass project root path. Make services available to tool functions.

tasks.name: Write MCP tool integration tests
tasks.description: End-to-end tests for each tool: ralph_providers returns filtered data, ralph_start creates job, ralph_status returns progress, ralph_summary returns summary, ralph_stop terminates job. Full lifecycle test: providers -> start -> poll -> summary -> stop.

acceptanceCriteria: All 5 tools are discoverable by MCP clients
Tool descriptions are clear and informative (from docstrings)
Tool parameter types are correct in JSON schema
ralph_providers returns filtered provider/model data
ralph_start creates job and returns within 5 seconds
ralph_status returns within 1 second
ralph_summary returns structured summary within 60 seconds
ralph_stop terminates running job
Error cases return clear JSON error messages (not exceptions)
Full lifecycle test passes: providers -> start(plan) -> poll -> summary -> start(build) -> poll -> summary

phases.name: Dashboard Integration
phases.description: Add ralph job monitoring to the Vista web dashboard with API endpoints and UI views

tasks.name: Create ralph API routes
tasks.description: Add REST API endpoints: GET /api/ralph/jobs, GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}, GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/progress, GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/output, GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts, GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts/{filename}, POST /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/stop. Wire to RalphService.

tasks.name: Register ralph routes in FastAPI app
tasks.description: Include the ralph router in the FastAPI app. Follow existing patterns from loops.py route registration.

tasks.name: Create ralph jobs list view
tasks.description: HTML template for ralph job list table with slug, mode, provider, model, status indicators, and timestamps. Auto-refresh for running jobs. Link to job detail view.

tasks.name: Create ralph job detail view
tasks.description: HTML template for job detail page: metadata header, progress section with auto-scroll, artifact file listing with click-to-view, stop button for running jobs.

tasks.name: Add ralph section to dashboard navigation
tasks.description: Add ralph jobs link to the dashboard navigation/sidebar. Update project page to show ralph job count.

tasks.name: Add ralph-specific CSS and JavaScript
tasks.description: Status indicator colors (blue=running, green=completed, red=failed, gray=stopped). Progress auto-refresh polling. Artifact file viewer modal or inline display.

tasks.name: Write dashboard API tests
tasks.description: Test all ralph API endpoints: list, detail, progress, output, artifacts, stop. Test 404 for nonexistent jobs. Test empty job list.

acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/ralph/jobs returns all jobs with correct metadata
GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id} returns full job detail
GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/progress returns progress.txt content
GET /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts lists all files
POST /api/ralph/jobs/{job_id}/stop terminates running job
404 returned for nonexistent job IDs
Job list view renders in browser with correct status indicators
Job detail view shows progress and artifacts
Auto-refresh updates status for running jobs
Dashboard navigation includes ralph jobs link
All dashboard API tests pass

phases.name: Settings UI Page
phases.description: Dashboard page for managing ralph settings through a friendly UI with live model discovery, provider/model toggles, cost tier dropdowns, and best-for tag selection

tasks.name: Create settings API endpoints
tasks.description: Add GET /api/settings/ralph (returns saved settings merged with live model lists from provider.get_models()), PUT /api/settings/ralph (saves ralph config back to settings.json preserving other sections), GET /api/settings/ralph/models (refresh-only live model discovery). The GET endpoint must include live_models from provider.get_models() alongside saved models_allowed/models_blocked/model_metadata.

tasks.name: Register settings routes in FastAPI app
tasks.description: Include the settings router in the FastAPI app.

tasks.name: Create settings page HTML template
tasks.description: Page at /settings/ralph with sections: Defaults (cascading provider/model dropdowns, iterations input), Summarizer (provider/model dropdowns), Providers & Models (per-provider enable toggle, per-model table with Allowed checkbox, Cost Tier dropdown [free/cheap/moderate/expensive], Best For Tags multi-select from predefined list, Best For Notes freeform text input). Save button writes to settings.json. Model table rows populated from live API data, never hardcoded.

tasks.name: Implement settings page JavaScript
tasks.description: Cascading dropdowns (changing default provider updates default model dropdown with live models). Multi-select for best_for_tags from predefined list. Dirty form detection (unsaved changes indicator). Save via PUT /api/settings/ralph with success/error toast. Refresh Models button calls GET /api/settings/ralph/models to re-discover without page reload. Loading state while fetching live models.

tasks.name: Add settings page CSS
tasks.description: Styles for the settings form: model tables, multi-select tag chips, cost tier dropdown colors, provider sections, save button states, unsaved changes indicator, warning badges for CLI-not-found and stale metadata.

tasks.name: Add settings link to dashboard navigation
tasks.description: Add Ralph Settings link to the dashboard sidebar/navigation alongside the Ralph Jobs link.

tasks.name: Write settings API tests
tasks.description: Tests for GET (returns merged live + saved data), PUT (saves correctly, preserves other sections), PUT validation (rejects invalid cost_tier, invalid provider references). Edge cases: missing CLI, stale metadata, empty settings, concurrent save.

acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/settings/ralph returns live_models from provider.get_models() for each provider
GET /api/settings/ralph returns saved models_allowed, models_blocked, model_metadata overlaid
GET /api/settings/ralph returns available_tags list of predefined best-for tags
PUT /api/settings/ralph saves config and preserves non-ralph sections in settings.json
Settings page model tables populated from live API data, never hardcoded
Provider enable/disable toggles work and reflect in ralph_providers MCP tool
Per-model Allowed checkboxes control models_allowed list
Cost tier dropdown saves correctly per model (free/cheap/moderate/expensive)
Best-for tags multi-select saves from predefined list per model
Best-for notes freeform text saves per model
Cascading dropdowns update model list when provider changes
Refresh Models button re-discovers without page reload
Unsaved changes indicator shows when form is dirty
Warning shown when provider CLI is not installed (empty model list)
Warning shown for stale metadata (model in settings but not in live_models)
All settings API tests pass
